name: You Stole my Heart!
source:
What happens when your date is late and suddenly dumps you over text? And now someone's broken into your home and they're wearing a… cat hoodie?? That's Amelia’s night so far and she's not about to let it be her worst without a fight. 

Can you help her have a perfect date or is she doomed to be alone on a Friday night!? 

[From [url=https://saltiepng.itch.io/you-stole-my-heart]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你的约会对象迟到并突然因为短信而甩掉你时，会发生什么？现在有人闯入你家，他们穿着……猫连帽衫？这是阿米莉亚迄今为止最难忘的一晚，她不打算让这成为她最糟糕的一天。

你能帮助她有一个完美的约会吗？还是她注定要在周五晚上独自一人！？

[来自[url=https://saltiepng.itch.io/you-stole-my-heart]itch.io[/url]]
